features: Multi-Function Health Monitoring: Features a heart rate sensor, activity records, sleep monitor, calorie counter, and blood pressure tracking to provide comprehensive health insights.
Smartphone Connectivity: Receive and reject calls, and send and receive messages directly from the band. Compatible with all smartphones via a downloadable app.
Daily Fitness Tracking: Keeps track of daily workouts, health metrics, and sleep quality to help you stay on top of your fitness goals.
Accurate Heart Rate Monitoring: Provides precise heart rate measurements to ensure effective workouts and health management.
1-Year Replacement Warranty: Comes with a 1-year replacement warranty across India, offering a new product replacement for any successful warranty claim.
